description: Enhanced browse/discover page with visual Instagram-style card grid. Trending projects sorted by rating. Includes SearchControls for keyword/category/tag/sort filters.

elements.label: Page header
elements.purpose: 'Discover' title + subtitle about exploring trending capstone projects

elements.label: Search & filter bar
elements.purpose: Keyword input, category dropdown, tag chips, sort selector (newest/oldest/price_asc/price_desc/rating)

elements.label: Visual card grid
elements.purpose: Responsive 1-3 column grid. Each card: status badge top-left, price top-right, title, description snippet (line-clamp-2), tags as pill badges, seller avatar+name bottom-left, review stars bottom-right
elements.schema_column_mapping: listings.id, listings.title, listings.price, listings.status, listings.description, listing_tags.tag, users.name, reviews.rating

state_rules.hover: card lifts (+translate-y) with shadow + border teal

elements.label: Bookmark/save icon
elements.purpose: Heart icon on each card — toggles bookmark in bookmarks table

state_rules.auth_required: redirect to /login if not logged in
